CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to contents was stated.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), organization/access (origin) and a separate status-like origin field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to a content's presentation/access was stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit coordinate sets are labeled with color attributes (red/blue) tied to named referents and current time.

D.rationale: The report lists content coordinates separately from an origin/organization field for the same referent/time, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation fields describe how contents are organized/presented (copied_prior_record, inherited_current, represented_time) for named referents.
